title: Interest registration failed
description: This event occurs when registration of an asset with product interest management fails.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Account identifier of the quota holder

reason_code.title: Reason code
reason_code.description: Code of the business rule that refused the registration

message.description: Description of error that occurred when trying to register new asset/quota
examples: This asset does not have any more available units
